events.title: Highest temperature in London on August 2?
events.description: This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the London City Airport Station in degrees Celsius on 2 Aug '26. The resolution source is https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/gb/london/EGLC. The resolution source measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius.
